method.baseline: Compare with the earlier normalized-correlation cue and exact 20 ms PCM differences using the identical clean reference. The noisy-reference historical study is a separate experiment.
method.candidate: A coherent match uses 240 ms Hann frames, 80 ms hops and three independent filtered bands from 300 to 3400 Hz. Evaluate local retained gain relative to both supported flanks. Reference-energy weighting reduces quiet frames and floor limits the coefficient extrapolation. Cross-band agreement uses the median of available signed deficits.
method.controls: Separate no-edit, local gain, same-speech resampling and global EQ controls. Ordinary different-performance, TTS and voice-converted same-word replacements are physical-change positives. The earlier copy is untouched in all positives.
method.input: A clean earlier copy of the same continuous six-second mono recording on the same 16 kHz sample clock. Test 0, -5 and -10 dB submission mixes with role-disjoint real competing speech. Include different-reader and same-words regenerated reference admission controls.
method.promotion: Continue only if the candidate locates at least four of six synthetic deliveries at -5 dB with at most one ordinary control flag, two reader groups covered, and zero flags on unrelated reference controls. No customer confidence weight.
method.thresholds: Use the strict maximum of each route on all ordinary development controls at all noise levels; seal before assessment. A localized range covers at least half the changed interval and reaches 0.30 interval IoU.
